claims.text: The target MPEA family exhibits room-temperature brittleness in its cast or homogenized state.
The room-temperature brittleness is caused by coarse grains, inadequate strain hardening, or brittle intermetallic phases.
Stepwise thermo-mechanical processing can produce multiple coherent precipitation structures while achieving high strength and ductility.
Hot working refines the grains and introduces dislocations.

The proposed processing schedule is homogenization at 1200 °C for 5 h, hot rolling at 1200 °C with 80% reduction, cold rolling at 25 °C with 75% reduction, annealing at 900 °C for 5 min, aging at 650 °C for 20 h, and water quenching.
A lower-temperature first aging stage nucleates coherent lamellar precipitates, after which a higher-temperature or longer second stage forms coherent spheroidal particles.
The resulting mediator consists of approximately 40 nm-wide shearable lamellae and approximately 10 nm coherent spheroidal particles.
The lamellar and spheroidal precipitates may have D0a, D022, or L12-type ordered structures.
Coherent lamellar precipitates can be sheared by dislocations, relieving stress concentrations and preventing cracking.
Fine coherent spheroidal particles provide order hardening and lattice-misfit strengthening while avoiding crack initiation.
The interaction of shearable lamellae and dislocation-pinning spheroids maintains high strain hardening and thereby overcomes the strength-ductility trade-off.
Relative to the approximately 600 MPa as-cast yield strength, the stepwise process can increase yield strength by more than 1.0 GPa.
The processed material is expected to reach a yield strength above 1.4 GPa and potentially approximately 2.0 GPa.
The processed material is expected to exhibit tensile ductility greater than 15% at room temperature.
Standard single-step aging typically produces coarse, incoherent precipitates, low strain hardening, and brittle fracture through crack initiation at incoherent interfaces.
The strategy is limited to MPEAs with sufficient thermodynamic driving force to form low-misfit coherent ordered precipitates that remain stable at the aging temperatures.

contradictions.description: The narrative describes a lower-temperature first stage followed by a higher-temperature or longer second stage, whereas the explicit intervention uses 900 °C for 5 min first and then the lower temperature of 650 °C for 20 h.
